title: windows cmd error: -4058, code: 'ENOENT' syscall: 'spawn /bin/bash'
body:
```
Error: spawn /bin/bash ENOENT
    at ChildProcess._handle.onexit (node:internal/child_process:285:19)
    at onErrorNT (node:internal/child_process:483:16)
    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:90:21) {
  errno: -4058,
  code: 'ENOENT',
  syscall: 'spawn /bin/bash',
  path: '/bin/bash',
  spawnargs: [ '-l' ]
}
```

as a workaround solution fix I managed to get it working in the git console

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f38cec6-23f1-417d-a051-4b7dd996a4d8)

**How to reproduce:**

install latest npm LTS, and open a cmd line on windows 10 and type claude
